classification.rationale: A consulting agreement between a company and a consultant with compensation, duration, confidentiality and termination clauses.

summarization.headline: Alder Strategy Group will assess Meridian Health Partners' patient-intake workflow for $42,000, effective January 1, 2024.
key_points: Fee of $42,000.00, paid half at signature and half on delivery of the final report.
Either party may terminate with fourteen days' notice.
summarization.term: Until acceptance of the final report
key_obligations: Consultant assesses the patient-intake workflow and recommends improvements
Consultant keeps patient and business information confidential
summarization.termination_terms: Either party may terminate with fourteen days' written notice; fees for completed work remain payable.
